title: Hearing of consumer dispute
description: Continuation of hearing by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission

steps.step: Mediation fails to settle the consumer dispute
The District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission continues to hear all the issues involved in the consumer dispute
